You are given 4 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) staged in the north safe-zone disc at (5,10) or the south safe-zone disc at (5,30) depending on seed (each radius 6). The enemy holds the centre: 2 anti-tank rocket soldiers at (30,19) and (30,21), with 1 heavy tank set back at (34,20) on Defend orders. Score 2 kills, return at least 3 tanks to either the (5,10) or (5,30) safe-zone disc, keep at least 3 tanks alive, within 4000 ticks.
